column1: # STEPS.tsv -- THE DESIGN-PLAN box-budget STEP TABLE (the cto, 2026-11-04, CTO-474/475/478; the design text in the shared-box skill's DESIGN section).

# harness/scripts/test_design_box_budget_steps.sh reads it: --list prints it; --step N runs the step's probe (column 5, one bash command run from S4E_HOME with a 600 s budget): rc 0 GREEN, rc 1 RED, rc 2 could not measure.
# Every probe reads a ledger or an instrument the step builds, so a step reads RED until its instrument exists and GREEN only while the box meets it; no probe is satisfied by a deletion.

column5: python3 harness/scripts/util_impact_set.py --root SCRIP --commit HEAD | grep -E '^IMPACT lang=[a-z0-9,]+ core=[0-9]+ shells=[0-9]+'

wt=/tmp/s4e/cto/box_budget_wt; rm -rf "$wt"; git -C SCRIP worktree prune; git -C SCRIP worktree add -q --detach "$wt" HEAD && echo >> "$wt/src/runtime/rt/rt.c" && bash harness/scripts/util_build_cache.sh fetch --root "$wt" 2>&1 | grep -q '^FETCHED'; rc=$?; git -C SCRIP worktree remove --force "$wt"; exit $rc
